result: Ptolemy's Book III-IV chapters provide a mechanism split that prevents common over-compression: employment has a lord/content/status hierarchy; relationships divide into intention, profit and mutual effect; travel divides into mobility, foreign opportunity and return conditions; family divides into source, resources and relational climate; fifth-house topics require an explicit choice between output, care and risk.
regression_requirements: one positive and one negative case for each mechanism split
no modern gender-essentialist or sensitive historical wording
no synastry or transit activation unless explicitly requested
deduplication against house-ruler-flow and event clusters
next_step: encode topic-specific mechanism selectors in the consultation planner and test them on existing family, career and work charts
